reviews.text: Very good with our senior dog we have been bringing here!

Please be careful when taking ur pets here . The owner of this place  took care of my german Shepard grooming service that completely changed my dogs attitude.
When i picked her up her eye was completely inflamed and red like she had gotten punched!
The owner mentioned she was being difficult when getting her hair dried . She could have stopped and called me to pick her up . Instead she went ahead and forced my dog on getting her hair dried that the collar ended up chocking.  she ended up popping my dogs eye vein from the pressure . She then mentioned she took her to the vet next door with out my consent and that everything was “ok”
She never called back to follow up on her and was very dismissive .

We are our pets voice!!! Be careful and do ur research

I have been taking my maltipoo and my toy poodle to Diana for years. Not only is she incredibly talented, she and her staff are always kind and professional. I have had other groomers there as well and my pups always look amazing. This is the first groomer I have taken them to consistently for years and wouldn't take them anywhere else!

Thank you so much for the five-star review, Ms.Amanda, and for trusting us with Bandit for so many years! We’re glad you feel his grooming is a great value. With prices rising everywhere, we know pet care costs matter to families. We use high-quality shampoos and products while doing our best to keep our services affordable for our clients. It’s always a pleasure to see Bandit, and we look forward to his next visit! 🐾❤️
Diana and the Hot Dog Grooming team

Absolutely amazing job! Our dog is reactive and can be aggressive during grooming, so he usually only gets partially groomed. Hot Dog Grooming is the first in years that groomed Bello fully and he looks super! Not an easy thing to accomplish with a Chow Chow!  Definitely Recommend!!

Update: The owner's response speaks for itself. My concern was never that prices increased; it was that a significant increase was not communicated beforehand and that my questions were not handled professionally. After three years as a customer, I expected a conversation, not a public attack. I encourage potential customers to read both my review and the owner's response and form their own conclusions:

I’ve been bringing my dogs here for the past 3 years, and until today, I had always had a positive experience. My groomer, Jose, has always been amazing and takes great care of my dogs.

However, today I finally met the manager, Ms. Diana, after noticing my grooming bill had suddenly increased by $120. When I reviewed the receipt, I simply wanted an explanation for the price increase and some communication about why it happened. Instead of having a calm discussion, I was met with raised voices and told that the employees had apparently been charging me incorrectly for years.

What frustrated me most was not necessarily the increase itself, but the complete lack of communication beforehand. Had someone called or texted me prior to the service to explain the updated pricing, I would have understood. Instead, I felt blindsided when I received the final receipt.

During the conversation, Ms. Diana continued to blame her employees rather than taking accountability or addressing my concerns professionally. She also insisted the pricing was clearly listed on the website, but I could not find those prices anywhere online.

By the end of the interaction, I honestly felt like I was the one trying to de-escalate the situation instead of the manager. It was disappointing after being a loyal customer for so many years.

My dog Blinky has an amazing time when he boards with Daniel at the Ranch. He loves all the loving staff and is always eager to hop out of the car when we get to the salon. We appreciate his groomer Diana for her amazing work. ❤️
Thank you so much for your ongoing support we greatly appreciate you

I just got my long haired cat groomed through their mobile spa.  I highly recommend them!  It took them about 25 minutes to de-mat and make my cat look like a kitten again.  It's hard to find a cat groomer, let alone a mobile one! My cat didn't run and hide or shy away from me after the grooming.  She seemed happy to be rid of some hair!  Thank you!!
Really loved my experience with Hot Dog Grooming. My dog was ready very quickly and he looked great! Definitely looking forward to returning for another appointment.
Jaxx had such a great experience! He came back clean, soft, and smelling amazing.
The groomer showed up on time and gave my big boy a really nice bath and deshed, trim nails, and a spiffy bandana!  Annie came home smelling all foo-foo nice🐕

I called this place. I was just asking the normal pricing questions:
How much is a full groom for a 60lb Siberian husky? Placed me on hold no big deal and quoted me 195 + tax now I’ve had my husky for 5 years so this was a big pricy in my eyes. So I asked how much would just a bath be? Quotes 95+ tax ok cool so I asked what all does the full grooming come with? He sighed deeply and hung up in my face. So I guess it was a bad time, either way unprofessional and honestly unprovoked. I asked 2 questions. I am sad because this place is so close to my house. But I guess I was right to not try this place out.

Unable to answer inquiries and failed to update google that they are unable to book appointments until the person in charge of pricing returns from “out of the country”.
The person who answered the phone either couldn’t or refused to put me in contact with upper management to book.
Mia and Bella have been going to Hot Dog Grooming for years!!  I always know my dogs will be cared for by great staff and I am never disappointed when I pick them up!

Velvet has been coming here for years-we’re always happy with the service, and even though we moved and aren’t able to get over here as often, we make the drive because they’re so good with her and know exactly the type of cuts I like.

My doodle always comes out happy as a clam, and the flexibility in scheduling is always a big help. I can usually get her in the day before and I love the bandanas they give her!
Diana and her staff are wonderful. She is deeply passionate about her business. The service at Hot Dog Grooming is top notch. Pierre is always happy after his grooming.
Friendly, professional, clean, quick. The vet said they couldn't trim my large dogs nails. Hot Dog Grooming made it seem easy. Very happy with everything. So is my dog. Highly recommend.
Best groomer on the westside of houston! Been trying to find a groomer for my dog that have anxiety when getting groomer. They treat my dog nice and always make sure he is satisfied

I do not recommend this place. They trimmed my dog’s nails and caused his thumb nail to bleed—without informing me. I only discovered it after noticing a trail of blood myself.

This experience made me feel that my dog’s well-being was disregarded reflecting a lack of attention and care... I would never trust them again.

[Update in response to the business’s reply:]
Thank you for your response, but I find it deeply disappointing — not only in tone but in how you’ve chosen to deflect responsibility by questioning my credibility and implying negligence on my part.

First, yes — I did attend your complimentary community nail trim event precisely to observe your approach before considering becoming a regular client. That doesn’t make the experience or my concerns any less valid. My review was about your business, your service, and the care my dog received — which I found lacking.

Second, your defensiveness and condescending insinuation that I don’t maintain my dog’s nails is not only unprofessional, it’s entirely inappropriate. It’s aggressive, dismissive, and a clear attempt to shift blame rather than taking accountability or expressing genuine concern. I shared what I experienced: I discovered my dog’s bleeding nail right after the visit — without any acknowledgment or warning from your staff. That’s the issue, and it’s one you’ve chosen to sidestep entirely.

This was a chance for you to show your values — but instead of addressing my concern respectfully, you chose to publicly challenge me. That speaks volumes about how you handle feedback and customer care. You may “take pride” in your work, but how you treat people when things go wrong is what truly reflects your business — and based on this, I would absolutely not trust my dog’s well-being to you again.
Highly recommend!! Have been going here for years. They always do a great job & the staff are very nice!
My senior baby has been groomed here twice. He's looked great every time! My directions and requests are followed and we couldn't be happier ~ I love and recommend Hot Dog Grooming
I’ve been taking my girls to this place for over a year now. From all the groomers I’ve tried this is by far the best. Their prices are decent and their service is great! I definitely recommend it!

We have been taking my dog to Hot Dog grooming for years. Even though we moved far from Hot Dog, we will always take her to Diana because we love her! Although, my baby is older and grumpy now, I comforted knowing that the staff at Hot Dog are very calming, kind and caring towards all animals. 🩷 …

Hate that it took me so long to find a groomer like this one. My dogs normally have anxiety while getting groomed but the groomers here are so loving and sweet they enjoyed their spa day as if mommies were grooming them. Our little picky princess even went to go give kisses and good byes to the groom which she never does; she is normally the first to run to the door. My babies response and actions spoke volumes ♥️
So happy we found our Furever groomer
Diana and her team are so awesome! My doggo comes back looking and smelling good, and not even stressed as I usually had experienced in other places. 10 out of 10!

Hot Dog Grooming does an excellent job on both our Shitzu and Goldendoodle!  Scheduling is easy, drop off/pick up easy, and the dogs look adorable.  We have had people ask who grooms our Goldendoodle.  Pricing is consistent with other grooming services.  Highly recommend!
This place is amazing. Diana does a wonder job on our poodle named Remi. This is the only place we take her, I definitely recommend.
My dog was matted, and I was having such a hard time finding a groomer. Hot dog groomers exceed my expectations, I am so happy my sister found them. Me and Shadow will be back for sure!!!
10/10 very loving and gentle!!! Highly recommended from tiktok also🥰🥰🥰 …

I really wanted to like this place, as the people are nice, location is convenient to home, it's relatively easy to schedule, and priced fairly. However, after trying them for a full groom 3 times for our golden retriever, we'll have to look elsewhere. Each time, they have used the clippers on the inside of his ears and it is so short that it ends up getting irritated and infected. This last time I gave very explicit instructions for no clippers anywhere, and especially not ears. Unfortunately, the instructions were not followed and we will be making another expensive trip to the vet. 3 stars for the reasons noted above but we will not be returning. Might be okay for a less sensitive dog.
Had a great grooming experiencing here for my toy poodle Nova. The coloring came out great and Diana and the staff were amazing. Great customer service overall and I’ll definitely be back.
This place has really given me hope that there are people who take pride in their work! Diana showcases her passion through her clients. 100% recommend Hot Dog Grooming!!
Very good attention, fast and efficient service, my dog came out  with the haircut I ask for , and amazing the aroma of their products. I loved it! 😊 …

I could not believe how fast the grooming appointment was. They did such a phenomenal job and took great care of my shy boy. Cost is great for the services they provide and the staff is so friendly! Thank you!
After countless attempts with other groomers big and small , we found imo the best in the city! Diana is super patient and you can tell she knows dogs and loves her job. I won’t go anywhere else

Diana has taken care of my dogs for over 10 years!!!  She truly loves dogs and treats them as her own!!!  When I tell my dogs we’re going to Hotdog they act like we’re going to Disneyland!!!  ❤️🙏. Thank you Diana and crew for the love you show to my little Buddies!! …

Great groomers, great service, clean environment
Give them a try you will be glad!!!!!!
Bad customer service! very rude attitude to customer!
